name: The Sealing of the Last Shoal
hook: Veyl's grief dreams loudest at the Last Shoal, a reef of seven Litany-crystals that holds the only un-erased memory of the god's first death. The Sealing Choir of the Mnemarchs has waded out at low brine to perform the Set Hour and lock the Shoal beyond all…
setup: Play on a 4x4 board divided into six numbered tide bands (1 nearest the dry shore, 6 furthest out to sea). Every band starts Brine-deep (wet side up) EXCEPT band 1, which begins Dry. Place SEVEN Litany-crystal models in a rough arc across the Shoal: one each in bands 1 and 6, two in band 2, and three clustered in bands 3 and 4 (the heart of the reef). All seven crystals begin Loose and Un-set. Build a physical Tide Track of six notches; place the Tide marker on notch 1. Place an empty Grief pool dish beside the board. Each band is a double-sided terrain overlay: wet side up = Brine-deep (auto-pass shatter, no Set possible), dry side up = Dry (Exposed crystals, Sealing possible). Set aside a…
deployment: ASYMMETRIC. The MNEMARCHS (defender) deploy first, anywhere in bands 4, 5, and 6 (the still-wet heart and seaward edge of the Shoal), in base contact with or within 3 inches of the crystals they intend to seal. The defender may declare any number of models as Choristers at deployment. The ASH ICONOCLASTS (attacker) deploy second, entirely along the dry shore edge behind band 1 — they begin on land, the wrong side of the water, and must advance INTO the receding sea as it dries before them. No attacker model may deploy past the band-1/band-2 line. The attacker has the first activation of round 1.
objectives: The crystals are the only objective; ground is worthless. A crystal scores for the side that owns its final state when the Toll strikes Dry. A crystal is SEALED (scores for the Mnemarchs) if a Chorister completed the Set Hour on it. A crystal is SILENCED (scores for the Iconoclasts) if it was Shattered and removed. A crystal that ends the game Loose, Un-set, and intact scores for NEITHER side. Count Sealed crystals for the defender and Silenced crystals for the attacker at the final Toll.
twist: THE SHOAL DROWNS ITSELF. The Iconoclasts cannot simply rush band 1, because Shattering feeds the Grief pool — and the Grief horde belongs to the attacker to place but answers to no one's victory.
